column1: # Reviewed OWASP ZAP baseline policy for the public static frontend.
# New rules remain WARN by default and therefore fail the workflow.

column3: Public static assets intentionally use reviewed CloudFront cache controls.
Frontend source comments must not disclose implementation details.
Reviewed false positive: allowlisted query values are assigned through DOM value properties, not HTML sinks.
CloudFront exposes the generic AmazonS3 origin header without a software version.
Only public static frontend content is cacheable; protected API responses are on a separate origin.
The CloudFront response policy must provide the required cross-origin isolation header.
